description: Bitcoin: Validate a Bitcoin address and get information about its type and scriptPubKey. Returns `isvalid: false` with an error message for invalid addresses; a string that isn't 2 to 130 letters and digits answers 400.

address.description:
Bitcoin address to validate: 2 to 130 letters and digits (a P2PK public key in hex is 130);
anything else answers 400, as mempool.space does
